title: Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Elf Bar 600 Bundle represents a significant evolution in the brand's celebrated lineup, offering a comprehensive package that transforms the most successful disposable vape into a sustainable, cost-effective prefilled pod system. This exclusive bundle includes two complete Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kits plus two additional prefilled pods. By providing two devices, this bundle allows you to keep one charged while using the other, or simply enjoy twice the flavour variety on the go. The device retains everything vapers value about the original – intuitive operation, clean design, and outstanding flavours – while introducing a smarter approach to everyday vaping. Built around a dependable 500mAh rechargeable battery, the system delivers up to 600 puffs per pod, maintaining the same consistent experience Elf Bar users expect. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, ensuring a crisp, satisfying Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw and rapid nicotine relief. With a plug-and-play design and no buttons to press, the Elf Bar 600 delivers premium performance in a pocket-friendly form factor that reduces waste while offering better long-term value. Available Bundle Flavours: The bundle grants access to the full spectrum of Elf Bar 600 flavours. Options range from bestsellers like Blue Razz Lemonade, Watermelon, and Apple Peach to refreshing blends such as Pink Lemonade and Strawberry Ice. Whether you prefer soda-inspired profiles like Cherry Cola or smooth classics like Snow Tobacco, there is a flavour to suit every preference. How To Set Up Your Elf Bar 600 Device Step 1 Remove the device and pod from the packaging. Step 2 Insert the prefilled pod into the device (plug and play). Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to activate the vapour. Step 4 Recharge the device via USB-C when the battery is low. ✅ Ready to vape
